display_name: 公开实测日志导入示例 · comma2k19
description: 公开实测数据的导入、单位和时间轴演示；不是本项目车辆动力学模型的实车标定证明。
vehicle: Toyota RAV4 (repository README identifies this dongle ID as RAV4)

publication.title: A Commute in Data: The comma2k19 Dataset
publication.authors: Harald Schafer, Eder Santana, Andrew Haden, Riccardo Biasini

steering_definition_note: The dataset's pinned openpilot submodule uses this cereal schema, where CarState.steeringAngle is under the 'steering wheel' section and measured in degrees. The exported dataset field itself is named CAN/steering_angle.

available_channels.time_s: seconds relative to first retained CAN speed sample
available_channels.speed_mps: original CAN speed in m/s, not km/h
available_channels.steering_angle_deg: CAN steering angle in degrees; steering-wheel convention of pinned openpilot schema

transformations: Verify each downloaded binary against its Git blob SHA-1 from the pinned official tree.
Read NumPy arrays with allow_pickle=False; require finite data and strictly increasing timestamps.
Keep speed samples only within steering's observed time interval; do not extrapolate.
Linearly interpolate steering on retained original speed sample timestamps; preserve speed measurements unchanged.
Subtract the first retained CAN speed time to produce relative seconds; retain original time interval in metadata.
Serialize to 9 decimal places. Do not filter, smooth, rescale speed, invent yaw/pressure, or derive a vehicle-model validation score.

allowed_demo_claims: Can parse a real public CAN log excerpt
Can handle asynchronous speed and steering sample times with documented linear interpolation
Can retain missing channels as missing
prohibited_claims: The lightweight dynamics model has been validated or calibrated on this vehicle
The excerpt reproduces a known controlled braking or lane-change experiment
Phone gyro Z is automatically the platform's vehicle yaw-rate without frame/calibration verification
